changeSet.author: ahri-medlab

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.system_role WHERE name = 'Project Roles'

changeSet.comment: Create Project Roles grouping role. Liquibase 043 skipped PI/Coordinator/Data Manager when this parent group was missing on older databases.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role (id, name, description, is_grouping_role, grouping_parent, display_key, active, editable) VALUES (nextval('clinlims.system_role_seq'), 'Project Roles', 'Project-scoped roles for notebook and research workflows.', TRUE, NULL, 'role.projectRoles', TRUE, TRUE);

changeSet.author: ahri-medlab
changeSet.comment: Seed AHRI SRS project roles under Project Roles group.
changeSet.sql: WITH role_seed(name, description, display_key) AS ( VALUES ('Principal Investigator', 'Project principal investigator.', 'role.principalInvestigator'), ('Project Coordinator', 'Project workflow coordinator.', 'role.projectCoordinator'), ('Data Manager', 'Project data analysis and reporting staff.', 'role.dataManager') ) INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role (id, name, description, is_grouping_role, grouping_parent, display_key, active, editable) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_role_seq'), seed.name, seed.description, FALSE, parent.id, seed.display_key, TRUE, TRUE FROM role_seed seed CROSS JOIN ( SELECT id FROM clinlims.system_role WHERE name = 'Project Roles' LIMIT 1 ) parent WHERE parent.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role existing WHERE existing.name = seed.name );

changeSet.author: ahri-medlab
changeSet.comment: Ensure CTD appears in User Management lab-unit dropdown (rename legacy Medical Laboratory).
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE clinlims.test_section SET name = 'CTD', description = 'CTD Department', is_active = 'Y', lastupdated = NOW() WHERE id = 181 OR name = 'Medical Laboratory' OR name = 'CTD';
UPDATE clinlims.localization loc SET english = 'CTD', french = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(loc.french), ''), 'CTD'), lastupdated = NOW() WHERE loc.id IN ( SELECT name_localization_id FROM clinlims.test_section WHERE name = 'CTD' OR id = 181 );
